notes: Main UI session summary and bounded logging. Session Summary shows total restarts and Roblox ErrorPrompt exits across watched VMs, plus current game uptime and time since the latest rejoin for the selected watched VM. Watchdog status now persists per-session counters/timestamps. Runtime log files are capped at the newest 500 lines, and Show Log reads/displays only the newest 500 lines using a backward tail reader to avoid loading large historical logs into memory.
